# IMO 1988, Problem 3  

This formalizes the linear recurrence deductions from Solution 1 
in "p3 1988.pdf".

Given the functional equations:
  f(2n) = f(n)
  f(4n+1) = 2f(2n+1) - f(n)
  f(4n+3) = 3f(2n+1) - 2f(n)

We prove the derived difference equations:
  f(4n+1) - f(4n) = 2(f(2n+1) - f(2n))
  f(4n+3) - f(4n+2) = 2(f(2n+1) - f(2n))
